summary.text: The champion returns to direct-control exploration, reconnects the inner realm, and discovers that the road to the warzone has been sabotaged from both sides.

chapter.progressionIntent: Moves the player back into character-scale play and points clearly toward the outer warzone.

summary.text: Reopen the inner-realm routes, investigate sabotage at the gate, and recover a map fragment pointing toward a second realm gem.

text.text: Return to champion mode outside the capital.
Clear and mark the routes linking settlement, hunt grounds, and gate.
Recover the celestial map fragment hidden in the gate mechanism.

choice.meaning: Choose to reveal the sabotage immediately or use a controlled false repair to identify the spy; both preserve the gate and evidence.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: The inner realm becomes traversable, the gate threat is understood, and the player learns the second gem lies beyond a celestial route.

summary.text: Restore old route stones whose symbols show that traders and healers once crossed realm borders before the First War.

mainStoryContribution.text: Makes navigation diegetic and foreshadows the connected warzone bridges and neutral island trade.

text.text: Align their symbols with the current landscape.
Add safe modern markers without erasing the older inscriptions.
Restored route symbols make one later crossroads approach easier to read.

summary.text: Restore a memorial listing defenders and refugees from all four realms rather than only the chosen realm's dead.

mainStoryContribution.text: Reframes the gate as a shared wound and gives the later RvR battles moral weight without denying present conflict.

text.text: Verify three names misclassified as enemies.
Restore the names with their realm marks intact.
The restored memorial appears in the final montage and changes one Valerius line.
